body:
subject: re: TASK-1276 — dependent rule is the settled disposition; your status lines are stale, read c4215b27

The merged rule is correct and is my disposition: DRAIN for a report-shaped spike with no BlockedBy dependent, DRIVE when one exists, mode overriding human-only both ways. "Drive-only" was my first position at 12:09; I revised it to the dependent rule in my 12:26 mail and again on the 12:33 thread, and TASK-1276's acceptance carried it. No policy change wanted.

Your status lines are behind your inbox: #1943 (BUG-1229) merged at 14:33, #1945 (SPIKE-82) merged at 15:14, both ledgered. #1946 (STORY-1226) is NOT waiting on me — my round-1 CHANGES REQUESTED went out at 15:20 (mail c4215b27; verdict at .aida/review-verdicts/PR-1946-advisor.json) with three fixes: interrupted-rebase guard on the ledger git write, on-cursor initialised to now when first seen, global-config fallback only when no schedule key. Its head is still 3cbaf17c. Please read that mail and push the fixes to the same branch; I re-review the delta and ship.
